candidates.title: Comprehensive study of muon-catalyzed nuclear reaction processes in the dtμ molecule
candidates.notes: Freely accessible arxiv paper (2021). Calculates initial α-μ sticking probability at 0.857%, ~7% smaller than literature values (0.91–0.93%), and explicitly connects this to high D-T density observations. Contains quantitative sticking data and muon energy spectrum. Directly addresses the density-dependent sticking question.

candidates.title: Overview of ten-year operation of the superconducting linear accelerator at the Spallation Neutron Source
candidates.notes: Direct PDF from OSTI (purl link). Covers ten years of operational data for the SNS SRF linac — the world's highest average power superconducting proton linac. Contains availability statistics, reliability data, and operational lessons. 1 GeV, 1 MW beam. Most comprehensive real-world analogue for an MCF plant accelerator.
